whyMe.title: Why me
whyMe.text: I enjoy turning ideas into applications that work reliably and are easy to use. What drives me is the moment a complex problem becomes a clean, understandable solution. I keep improving my skills through my own projects, code reviews and new technologies.

skills.title: My Skill Set
skills.text: In several projects I have built web applications with Angular, TypeScript and JavaScript, from the first layout to a working app with a database. I learn new technologies quickly and enjoy working my way into tools I have not used before.
skills.challenge: Need a technology I haven't used yet? I'm happy to learn it and use it in your project.

work.title: My Work
work.ongoing: I am currently building a backend with Docker and a CI/CD pipeline. My focus is on security from the start: automated tests, dependency checks and clean deployments. Good planning makes the difference between a project that runs and one that lasts.

join.about: Kanban task manager. Create tasks, assign contacts and move them by drag and drop. Stakeholders can send requests by e-mail, an AI workflow turns them into tasks.
join.third: Team project with two teammates, I was responsible for the final submission. On my own I then added an AI workflow: n8n reads incoming e-mails, Gemini turns them into structured tasks and saves them in the Triage column.

polloLoco.about: Jump, run and throw game based on an object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
polloLoco.third: Solo project. I learned to plan a class structure before coding: character, chickens and final boss inherit from one shared base class, so movement and collision logic exists only once.

dabubble.about: Slack-like team chat with channels, direct messages, threads and reactions in real time, including Google and guest login.
dabubble.third: Planned as a team project, but with too few participants I built it on my own in Angular with signals and Firebase. I learned to secure data with Firestore rules (deny by default, members only) and to keep many real-time listeners clean and fast.

contact.title: Contact me
contact.text: Looking for a developer who enjoys both frontend and backend? Tell me about your team and the role you have in mind. I am motivated to contribute from day one and to keep growing with your projects.
